judged_text: The refactor inverts the team-billing condition for the organization slug: `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` became `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`, so the slug is now written exactly when it previously was withheld, and withheld when it previously was written. When team billing is disabled (self-hosted installs), newly created organizations get no slug but get requestedSlug in metadata instead, and when billing is enabled they get a raw slug without the requestedSlug/verification flow — the organization-creation objective (slug gated behind billing/verification) is silently reversed for every user.
